verdict.rationale: n8n ships its own core node titled "MCP Client" in its LangChain/AI node set, so it does document a capability to connect to external MCP servers. The evidence is only the docs page title, though, and does not show how agents discover and call the connected servers' tools. missing for 10: documented detail on configuring MCP server connections and on agents using the exposed tools, supported transports/auth, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
